label: Settings Menu
description: Gantt chart with settings menu and schedulable rows. Best for a Settings menu of display switches (today line, weekends, arrows, plans, rollups, week start) and 5 time zones, over empty rows the toolbar schedules one by one.

label: Drag Reorder
description: Gantt chart with reorderable tree rows. Best for the leanest setup, where one callback gives every tree row a reorder menu and a single setState keeps the new order.

label: Quarter Roadmap
description: Gantt chart with quarter roadmap and rollups. Best for multi month initiatives grouped by workstream, with a toolbar button that drops the next backlog item onto its empty row.

label: Capacity Board
description: Gantt chart with weekly capacity board. Best for teammates grouped by squad with avatar row labels and shaded weekends, where added assignments stack into extra lanes.

label: Task Table
description: Gantt chart with task details and progress. Best for a read only status report whose tree column shows each task's owner and status badge, with rows added from the toolbar.

label: Baseline Tracking
description: Gantt chart with as-built baseline tracking. Best for frozen plan dates ghosted behind actual bars, showing early, late and on time work plus a planned band on a whole group.

label: Dependencies & Milestones
description: Gantt chart with dependency arrows and milestones. Best for a rollout chain where QA waits on 2 build tracks and a zero length sign off gate opens the go live step.

label: Working Days
description: Gantt chart with working-day adjustment. Best for moves that land on a weekend or a holiday and settle on the next working day, keeping each task's working-day length.
